edges.reason: Constructor stores _msgSender() as the owner.
transfer uses _msgSender() as the sender of funds.
transferFrom spends the allowance of _msgSender() and updates it.
approve sets the allowance for _msgSender() as owner.
manualswap gate is a raw require(_msgSender() == _marketingAddress) rather than a role check.
manualsend gate is a raw require(_msgSender() == _marketingAddress) rather than a role check.
_listBot and allowance lookups are keyed by _msgSender() inside _transfer.
block.timestamp is stored as lockedFrom when locking a bot, making vesting timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is stored as lockedFrom for hard locks, making vesting timestamp dependent.
daysPassed is derived from block.timestamp allowing miner manipulation of unlock progress.
openTradingTime and the liquidity deadline both come from block.timestamp.
Cooldown check block.timestamp < openTradingTime + 30 seconds is timestamp dependent.
block.timestamp is passed as the swap deadline to the router.
transfer forwards the call to _transfer.
transferFrom forwards the call to _transfer.
transferFrom decrements the allowance via _approve.
approve writes the allowance via _approve.
_transfer calls _tokenTransfer which reaches _transferStandard.
_transfer triggers swapTokensForEth when swapEnabled and not in swap.
_transfer sends accumulated ETH to the fee address above the threshold.
_transfer calls remainBalanceLocked for locked bots.
_transfer reads _listBot[from].locked and .hardLock.
_transfer sets _redistributionAddress tax before computing values.
_transfer sets _feeAddr2 tax before computing values.
_tokenTransfer delegates to _transferStandard.
_transferStandard credits the team fee via _takeTeam.
_transferStandard reflects the fee via _reflectFee.
_transferStandard updates _rOwned for sender and recipient.
_takeTeam adds the team reflection to the contract balance.
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal.
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal.
manualswap calls swapTokensForEth which performs an external router call against the full contract balance.
manualswap reads the full contract token balance via balanceOf.
manualsend forwards the entire ETH balance to the fee sender.
swapTokensForEth performs an external call to the Uniswap router supporting fee-on-transfer tokens.
sendETHToFee performs an external ETH transfer to the marketing address.
openTrading performs an external payable addLiquidityETH call with the whole contract balance.
openTrading calls the factory createPair which returns the pair address stored afterwards.
openTrading stores the router address in uniswapV2Router.
openTrading stores the created pair address in uniswapV2Pair.
openTrading sets openTradingTime from block.timestamp.
openTrading approves the router and the pair via _approve.
remainBalanceLocked calls _getBalanceUnlocked.
remainBalanceLocked reads _listBot initLockedBalance.
_getBalanceUnlocked reads the bot LockBot struct.
addToListBotNormal writes a LockBot entry into _listBot.
addToListBotHardLock writes a hard-locked LockBot entry into _listBot.
removeLockBot clears the locked and hardLock flags in _listBot.
remainBalanceLocked subtracts the unlocked balance from initLockedBalance and can revert or misbehave if the lock state is inconsistent.
_getBalanceUnlocked multiplies daysPassed by initLockedBalance before dividing by LOCK_BOT_DAYS.
setCooldownEnabled toggles the cooldownEnabled flag.
liftMaxTx resets _maxTxAmount to the full supply.
renounceOwnership clears the stored owner.
balanceOf reads the reflection balance from _rOwned.
balanceOf converts reflections to tokens via tokenFromReflection.
tokenFromReflection validates against _rTotal and uses the current rate.
Transfer amount parameter flows into _transfer validation and accounting.
Bot address parameter is used as the _listBot key and balanceOf target.
tAmount parameter drives fee and reflection computations in _transferStandard.
daysPassed local is used in the unlock multiplication and division arithmetic.
lockedBalance local holds the result of remainBalanceLocked used in the bot transfer check.

normalization_plan.reason: The amount parameter only carries transfer input into _transfer; it has no independent security meaning.
The bot address parameter is written straight into _listBot and has no behaviour outside the lock functions.
tAmount is a derived transfer amount consumed by the standard transfer accounting path.
daysPassed is a transient computation of block.timestamp based vesting used only for the unlock amount.
lockedBalance is a transient local holding remainBalanceLocked output inside the transfer guard.
